title: Labwise · 实验报告辅助评阅
summary: Evidence-led AI assistance for university lab reports: understand the source, review rubric-linked suggestions, and keep final scores and feedback in the instructor's hands. 帮助教师理解英文实验报告、核对原文证据并形成可审核的反馈。
problem:
Reviewing an English lab report means understanding scientific reasoning, checking assignment requirements, locating evidence and writing useful feedback across several tools. Labwise brings those steps into one teacher workspace.

项目从中国高校非英语母语教师的需求出发，关注英国大学体系下的实验报告写作与 Rubric 对照：降低英文阅读和证据查找成本，同时保留教师的专业判断。
architecture:
Assignment + rubric snapshot → DOCX parsing and source anchors → background AI candidates → linked source, outline and teacher review → instructor confirmation → Word feedback package.

HTML/CSS/JavaScript provide the reading and review interface; Python serves the local API, SQLite stores drafts and revisions, and the backend calls the configured DeepSeek service. Local LibreOffice and bundled PDF.js support relevant document rendering paths.
designPhilosophy:
Understand before assessing. Every candidate should point back to a real paragraph, quotation or figure object and the current rubric. AI completion and teacher completion are separate states.

先理解，再评阅；原文证据与评分标准共同约束建议。教师逐条采纳、编辑或拒绝，确认最终分数与反馈。无法定位或覆盖不足的内容保留为待核实，不能靠猜测补全。
implementation:
The local pilot includes assignment/rubric maintenance, DOCX import, automatic analysis queues, evidence-linked suggestions, draft/revision persistence, continuous review and instructor-confirmed Word review packages. New student submissions are DOCX-only; historical PDF records remain readable.

目前为持续开发的教师试点。网站展示项目记录与历史验证截图，完整工作流需在本机运行 Python 服务。截图均来自虚构软件测试；早期手动图表入口不代表当前 Word 优先流程。
reflection:
The quality goal is faster understanding and better-grounded feedback, not automated final grading. Evaluate evidence accuracy, rubric alignment, unsupported suggestions and reasons for teacher edits before expanding the pilot.

后续重点是复杂文档覆盖、引用内容证据链和稳定回归。学校身份、课程权限、LMS/Turnitin 对接及多人校准属于后续规划。当前快照仍有已知回归失败，尚未宣称生产就绪；没有经过验证的效率提升百分比。
workflow: Create an assignment and verify the rubric / 创建作业并核对评分细则
Import DOCX reports and queue analysis / 导入 Word 报告并自动分析
Read the source alongside evidence-linked candidates / 对照原文审核建议
Accept, edit or reject; enter scores / 采纳、编辑或拒绝并录入分数
Confirm feedback and continue reviewing / 确认反馈后继续评阅
Export the instructor-approved review package / 导出教师确认的批改包
downloadNotes: Complete source ZIP from main; not a standalone installer. Follow the repository setup instructions for Python dependencies, AI configuration and optional Word conversion. macOS has a start.command entry; Windows setup still needs separate validation. 完整源码下载不含学生资料、数据库或密钥。
